facts: Parties: Merrion Industries Ltd (Buyer), Penrith Energy plc (Seller); the Company is Elstree Capital LLP.
This Agreement is dated 28 December 2025; Closing is scheduled for 13 February 2026 (the 'Closing Date').
Section 4.5: if the Conditions are not satisfied by the date falling 120 days after the date of this Agreement (signed 28 December 2025), either party may terminate.
Section 3.4 (Earn-out): the Earn-out Payment equals 3 times the amount by which FY2026 EBITDA exceeds $4,000,000, capped at $3,000,000.

Section 9.3 (Limitation of Liability): the aggregate liability of the Seller for warranty claims shall not exceed an amount equal to 15% of the Purchase Price, being $8,100,000. The Purchase Price is $45,000,000 (see Section 2.1).

Disclosure against Warranty 8.2 (IP): the Company's core platform software was developed in 2023 by an independent contractor, Whitlock Systems Ltd. No written assignment of intellectual property was entered into.
Disclosure against Warranty 6.3 (Material Contracts): no material contract contains a change of control provision. (No further disclosure.)
Regulatory counsel expects merger clearance by 11 June 2026.
Management accounts show FY2026 EBITDA of $4,800,000; the Seller says the Earn-out Payment will therefore be $3,300,000.

Clause 14.2: either party may terminate this agreement on 30 days' notice if the other party undergoes a change of control without its prior written consent. The counterparty is Redcliffe Robotics Ltd.
